deadline.value: No central call: apply to advertised open positions or contact group leaders directly. After a group accepts you, the UZH Admissions Office window for Fall-semester doctoral studies is 1 January to 31 July (pre-application required)
deadline.quote: If you are interested in obtaining a PhD at our institute, you can directly look for and apply to open positions here. You may also contact the group leaders of the individual research groups directly to ask about open PhD positions.

also.quote: Doctoral Studies Please note that a pre-application is necessary. For more information please see admission procedure. 1 January until 31 July

gre_subject.value: Not stated on the page checked

supervisor.value: A group leader must accept you and sign a Confirmation of Supervision; the Admissions Office cannot admit you without it
supervisor.quote: Your supervisor needs to sign the Confirmation of Supervision and send it together with your CV, bachelor and master diploma as well as your transcript of records to the head of the graduate school.

also.quote: the Admissions Office decision on admission (see point 3 above) cannot be issued until confirmation of supervision

funding.value: PhD students are normally salaried; the department says the salary covers local living costs including social and health insurance
funding.quote: The salary will allow you to cover all the local living expenses including all the necessary social and health insurances.

entry_route.value: Master's degree in physics required (students about to finish their master's may apply)
entry_route.quote: The prerequisites for the admission to the doctoral program in physics consist of a Master's degree in Physics. Students who have successfully completed their Master (or are about to do so) can apply for PhD positions in physics at the University of Zurich.

app_fee.value: CHF 100 UZH application fee for doctoral studies (non-refundable)
app_fee.quote: Bachelor's and Master's Degree, Teaching Diploma and Doctoral Studies 100.— | Application fees will not be refunded or credited against other fees.

notes: Faculty of Science (MNF). 12 ECTS of coursework; PhD usually takes 3–4 years. Non-EU/EFTA citizens need a visa and work permit (UZH generally applies on your behalf), and processing can take up to three months.
